{/* HERO SECTION */}

See Your Food. Track Nutrition. Cook Smarter. Waste Less.

SeeFood is an AI-powered food assistant that helps you track nutrition from ready meals or plan meals using raw ingredients from your fridge — making healthy eating effortless.

{/* WHY SEEFOOD */}

Why SeeFood?

📸 See Your Food

Take a photo of your meal and instantly get calorie count, nutrition breakdown, and portion size estimates.

🥗 Eat Smarter

Track what you eat and make healthier decisions based on real nutritional data.

♻️ Reduce Food Waste

Use ingredients before they expire by turning leftovers into meal ideas.

{/* CORE FEATURES */}

Two Smart Ways to Use SeeFood

Whether your food is already cooked or still raw — SeeFood helps you make smarter choices.

{/* READY MEALS */}

🍱 Ready Meals — Track Nutrition Instantly

Already have food? Just take a photo. SeeFood analyzes your meal, estimates calories, portion size, and nutritional value so you know exactly what you’re eating.

{/* RAW INGREDIENTS */}

🥦 Raw Ingredients — Plan Meals From Your Fridge

Want to cook but don’t know what to make? Scan your fridge to detect ingredients, and SeeFood will suggest meal recipes using what you already have — before food goes to waste.

{/* HOW IT WORKS */}

How It Works

1️⃣ Take a Photo or Scan Your Fridge

Upload a meal photo or scan ingredients using your phone or Telegram bot.

2️⃣ AI Analyzes Food

Our AI detects food items, estimates portion sizes, and calculates nutrition.

3️⃣ Track or Cook Smarter

Track your meals or get recipe suggestions using what you already have.

{/* TRUST / TARGET USERS */}

Built for Students, Busy People & Health-Conscious Users

SeeFood helps people eat healthier, save money, reduce food waste, and make smarter meal decisions — all in one place.

{/* FINAL CTA */}

Ready to See Your Food Smarter?

Join SeeFood and start tracking meals or planning recipes today.
